acceptance: A changed staged diff makes the attempt invalid, with a test
A decision on credential concurrency is recorded, or the groups are restored
The stand-in window behaviour on pending reviews is decided and documented
context: Part (1) is done in #2798 (merged 2026-10-09, 7b639aba1): the runner hashes the staged diff before and after a review and records the reviewer as invalid when it changed, with a test. Parts (2), credential concurrency, and (3), the stand-in window on pending reviews, remain open.
description: Low findings deferred on #2769: (1) stage_pull_request_diff adds .oracle-pull-request.diff to info/exclude, so the post-review `git status` integrity check cannot see a reviewer rewrite it; hash it before and after the run, or stage it outside the checkout. (2) Removing the per-credential concurrency groups lets runs for different pull requests use one reviewer credential at the same time. (3) The stand-in window ignores later pending or integrity-withheld oracle reviews.
